jump to other results
  1.  
    accomplish something to succeed in doing or completing something synonym achieve
    • The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
    • I don't feel I've accomplished very much today.
    • That's it. Mission accomplished (= we have done what we aimed to do).
    Topics Successb2
    Oxford Collocations Dictionaryadverb
    • successfully
    • easily
    See full entry
  2. accomplish something (South-East Asian English) (in the Philippines) to complete a form by writing information on it
    • The form may be accomplished digitally or by hand.
    3. Word Originlate Middle English: from Old French acompliss-, lengthened stem of acomplir, based on Latin ad- ‘to’ + complere ‘to complete’.
